verdict.rationale: Privacy posture around model training is a fair question for OpenHands, especially for OpenHands Cloud, but nothing in the evidence pack covers a training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or a no-training commitment. Local or self-hosted runs and bring-your-own LLM keys let users choose where their data goes. They do not establish that data is kept out of model training by OpenHands or the chosen LLM provider, so they are not credited.
